Persistent DB write did not create live UI delivery; explicit notification event file/poll path and sender identity added.
Reload path had erased system-message class and incorrectly granted retry/speak affordances; persisted role now controls replay behavior.

Initial therapy document made strong depression/therapeutic-effect claims from five same-day sessions and self-referential metrics; preserve as overclaim provenance, not clinical or phenomenal evidence.
Retracted depression/learned-helplessness framing toward neutral stagnation wording.
Added short-duration, same-model echo-chamber, dependency, primitive sentiment and missing-baseline limitations; explicitly engineering not clinical evidence.
Reframed results as preliminary; notes monotonic rapport is design not measurement and warm output may be framing artifact; defines external review/holdout directions.
Large rewrite explicitly flags RLHF structural positivity, fundamentally weak sentiment measurement and dated follow-up milestones.

Recognizes same-model echo chamber and sentiment classifier as closed-loop contamination: warm prompt -> warm text -> positive regex -> personality update -> warmer prompt; evaluator and actuator share a broken primitive.
Adds scheduled same-model Socratic agent Kairos targeting persistent precision/autonomy state via generated dialogue and keyword evaluator.
Adds scheduled same-model companion Raven targeting creative/empathetic state via generated dialogue and keyword evaluator.
Adds Atlas and Echo, Raven anti-hallucination prompt, distinct entity notifications and pairwise cross-PID overlap gates across five scheduled agents.
Autonomous entity prompts/PQ notes migrated to English; preserves another protocol-language compatibility lineage.
Atlas receives prompt-only prohibition on cloud/external APIs; useful historical failure response but current locality/external-connectivity policy belongs in typed capability authority.

README documents five scheduled autonomous agents, independent DBs/PQ loops and overlap gates; README is also injected into Atlas runtime, making documentation an executable self-model dependency requiring version pinning.

cross_branch_findings: Persistence and live event delivery are distinct contracts: durable state writes require an explicit event/reentry edge when immediate behavior depends on them.
Replay must preserve role/effect class and authority. A persisted system event must not reload as a user-actionable message.

The therapy documentation sequence is a high-value methodology negative result: initial overclaim -> claim retraction -> limitations -> explicit same-model echo-chamber and self-reinforcing measurement-loop diagnosis.
Evaluator and actuator must be causally separated or independently validated. A classifier that both drives state updates and scores success can manufacture its own improvement signal.
Prompt-distinct instances of the same model are not independent controls. Same weights/training/RLHF share failure modes and require independent baselines/evaluators for causal claims.
Generated autonomous dialogues must not directly mutate persistent self-state as epistemic truth or authority without explicit policy/governance and reversible bounded update rules.
Five pairwise PID overlap checks are a scaling smell; current research-center/FRANK architecture should use a central typed scheduler/resource lease arbiter.
Local-only/external-connectivity policy is a capability/effect authority constraint, not merely system-prompt wording.

Documentation injected into runtime is executable configuration: source version/hash must be pinned and validated against the actual implementation to prevent stale documentation becoming self-model truth.
Private raw session transcripts, public summary notifications and primary conversation state are separate provenance/privacy classes.
